There are massive startup opportunities hiding in plain sight : every layer of the computing stack will need to be rebuilt for agents. For the last few years, most of the focus has been on making enterprise software agent-ready: APIs, connectors, MCPs. Now personal agents are forcing the same conversation for consumer products - e-commerce is an early example. This is just the tip of the iceberg.
